reranked_evidence.title: Music and Arts Festival- Free Community Event | City of Corona, CA
reranked_evidence.snippet: # Music and Arts Festival- Free Community Event. The **City of Corona** invites you to celebrate creativity, culture, and community at the 2nd Annual Music & Arts Festival! Join us for an unforgettable day filled with live music, local art, and interactive experiences for all ages. If you love live music and creative art this is a free event is one you don't want to miss. Bring out your lawn chairs and blankets and enjoy an exciting lineup of musicians and performers bringing energy and sound to the heart of Corona. Get ready for an electrifying lineup as **Upstream**, **Tori Green**, **High D Boys**, and **No Jac** take the stage. Take a walk inside of the Community Room at the Civic Center for the Art Show Showcase displaying art from residents. Corona Art Association will curate the Community Art Exhibit in the Community Room at the Historic Civic Center during the Music & Arts Festival.

reranked_evidence.snippet: # Closed due to coronavirus: List of activities and state shutdowns over COVID-19 outbreak concerns. The novel coronavirus continues to spread in the U.S. Cities and states are restricting large gatherings of people, and even presidential hopefuls are canceling rallies. Here is a list of events and destinations that have been affected by the outbreak. The NBA has abruptlysuspended its season "until further notice." The decision came after a Utah Jazz player tested positive for COVID-19 ahead of Utah's game against the Oklahoma City Thunder. At the time the NBA decided to suspend the season, a plan was not yet in place for when the league would resume. The leaguesaid in a statementon March 16 the move was made in accordance with recommendations from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention against gatherings of 50 people or more for eight weeks. The United States Soccer Federationannouncedit would cancel upcoming men's and women's national team matches in March and April.
